meta_description:
22 likes, 1 comments - the_temptationalley on February 3, 2026: "It’s 2025 and going to 2026 soon. If you still think salads are boring wait until you try this salad. It’s perfect for large party gatherings and comes together in no time.
.
You can add orange juice instead of lemon juice and add capers if you have it will elevate the flavour of the recipe. 
.
Note - I have not added salt as I added in beans while blanching but if you need salt toh can definitely add it.
- make sure you Blanche your beans in heavy salted water and immediately keep it in ice cold water ( Blanche for 3-4 mins ) beans should not be mush it needs to have crunch. 
- I have boiled the potatoes before airfrying it. ( Airfryer for 10 mins at 200 * ) 
.
Ingredients - 2 -3 handful of beans 
- 3 potatoes 
- 2 garlic 
- 1/2 onion 
- 3 olives chopped 
- 1 tbsp honey 
- 2 tbsp lemon juice 
- 1 tsp Dijon mustard 
- 5-6 tbsp olive oil 
- 3-4 tbsp corn 
- 1/2 tsp oregano and 1/2 tsp chilli flakes 
.
#saladsofinstagram #saladrecipe #beansalad #greenbeans #healthyfoodrecipes highproteinmeals whatiateforlunch whatieatinday whatsforlunch mediterraneanflavors crispypotatoes crispypotato".
